Robust attention pooling (robust_attention) over the CheMeleon + GraphMVP + MoLFormer encoders; output_dim=300, entropy-regularization weight=0.01, attention-temperature annealing over 15 epochs, modality_dropout=0.2, residual + pre-norm. Single-task bottleneck head (one head per endpoint, single-task loss); no cross-task weighting.
